response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level generalist software engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and infrastructure, but the resume shows almost no evidence of the core requirement: 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions. His only AI-adjacent work is a few months in his current role touching MCP tooling and 'AI-agent infrastructure' — far short of the depth needed. There is no mention of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation, or cloud-based AI system design, all of which are explicitly required or preferred for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level software engineering experience across diverse stacks and industries
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, open-source work, and public speaking/workshops
concerns: No Python in skill set or work history despite it being a required language for AI-driven development
No demonstrated experience with vector databases, RAG pipelines, or data pipelines for structured/unstructured data
AI/GenAI-specific experience appears limited to only a few months, far below the 8+ years required

key_factors.factor: No evidence of RAG, vector DB, or LLM evaluation expertise
Strong general staff-level engineering and leadership background
